name: WayriCAD Quick EMerge (beta)
description: Interactive EMerge 3+ antenna and saved-PCB rule-area simulations (beta).
description_full: Beta read-only native electromagnetic workbench with antenna/coupon templates, reviewed two-layer PCB rule-area copper extraction, interactive 3D and 2D views, linked field probes, S-parameters, radiation plots and exports. An isolated dependency manager installs EMerge 3+ on first open and qualifies updates before activation, retaining rollback. Only documented integration modes are supported; this does not expose every upstream EMerge capability. Bare PEC copper and homogeneous real-permittivity models omit components, losses and PCB outside the selected enclosure. Coarse compatibility solves do not establish accuracy or convergence. Requires a saved PCB, KiCad 10 native Python and internet for initial setup.
